resources.string: Practice mode: type in the language you\'re learning, and your friends receive it in theirs; you see what you typed in the bar above the keys. Direct mode: type in your own language as usual, and the bar shows it live in the language you\'re learning. The ES | EN switch above the keys shows which language you\'re typing in; tap the other one to change.
I type in (the language I\'m practising)
It gets sent in (my friends\' language)
There\'s no %1$s keyboard layout yet, so you\'ll get QWERTY.
In direct mode you type in %1$s, so the keys switch to its layout.
Language packs ready ✓ — translation works offline.
Language packs need downloading (about 30 MB each).
Slide across the letters to type a word, without lifting your finger.
Word suggestions above the keys. Ignores accents, so typing \"cancion\" offers \"canción\".
Fixes typos and missing accents when you press space. Backspace straight after undoes it.
Word lists: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, from OpenSubtitles, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Tap here and type with Language Keyboard

Tips: the ✓ key (where Enter usually is) locks in the current translation. Tap EN on the ES | EN switch for direct mode: type straight in your friends\' language and see it in the language you\'re learning above the keys. Tap ES to go back. Tap a suggestion to use it; tap your own word (in quotes) to keep it and teach it to the keyboard. Hold and slide along the space bar to move the cursor. Long-press a letter for accents. Use the 🌐 button under the keyboard to switch keyboards.
Type in %1$s to see it in %2$s here
Couldn\'t download the language pack. Open settings (⚙) to retry.
Address bar: tap %1$s to practise here
Typing in %1$s (practice mode). Tap to type in your own language.
Typing in %1$s (direct mode). Tap to practise.
\"%1$s\" isn\'t in the %2$s word list. Check the spelling.
Possible mistakes are marked. Fix them, or press ✓ again to use it as it is.
No suggestion. Tap ✕ to leave it.
Puts a red squiggly line under misspelt words and missing accents in the practice bar. Tap the word to see the fix. Works offline.

Also checks grammar, like gender agreement and verb forms (blue squiggly line), and explains each mistake. Sends the text in the practice bar to LanguageTool (languagetool.org) when you pause typing. Free, no account. Your friends\' translation isn\'t sent.
